title: UI wave 2 U14: Split view integration (K, part 2)
description: Plan task U14. Follow docs/agent-work/2026-10-26-ui-wave-2/PLAN.md exactly: this task's section (Files, Interfaces, Steps, Acceptance check, Fail-first, Stop-and-ask, Default) plus the seven answered Open questions and the Notes for the implementer. Protocol: register the serial check slot via files add only right before the first expensive check and keep it until done; pinned Node; quoted --outDir; no installs, no commits; status CLAIMED; independent review required.

review.note: APPROVE (reviewer agent-6a1e, data-safety bar). Fresh build of the shared tree (ui2-u14-review/dist, port 1563; NOTE the tree already contains in-progress T123 edits by the same worker, e.g. untracked src/research/BibliographyPage.tsx): tsc 0; vitest split+save-queue 47/47. My probe (ui2-u14-review/probe/split-safety.spec.mjs) x3: P1 P2 P3 P5 P4b P5b P8 + new U1 (New section while focused right: split stays, new section in the right pane, fragment only from it, one/two untouched, survives reload), U2 (read-title for the entry in the UNFOCUSED pane focuses that pane, fragment only from it), U3 (select in right, focus left via sidebar, Keep: no cross-entry text) -> 30/30 (probe3.log). Original unmodified probe: P4 fails only at its impossible precondition (card read-only since c2) and P6/P7 only at their 'split closed' line (U14 deliberately keeps the split; U1/U2 replace them with stricter checks) (probe1.log). Worker probe copy P1-P15 x3 48/48 (wprobe3.log; I read its P12 Go to passage, P13 Reattach, P14 passage restore, P15 cases: data assertions are real, other entries checked untouched). split-view --repeat-each 3 29/30: the one failure is the known U13 menus case line 202 (Georgia mark late); my instrumented copy x10 shows left=1 right=0 every time, so no cross-pane formatting, just timing (menus10.log). fragments-panel+research+comments+revisions+sidebar-selection+accessibility 32/33: the failure is research.spec:361, T123's new in-progress Bibliography test, not T111. Code read: openEntry reads splitRef (set in render, changeSplit and remove) so post-await/dialog jumps use live panes; editorFor resolves from splitPanes (what is drawn) so it cannot return an editor for a stale split entry; extract refuses unless the calling editor is editorFor(active); finishReattachment uses editorFor(entryId); whole-version restore still closes the split; remove prunes via splitRef. Screenshots viewed (probe-results/shots-*): open-beside 16 px two-column icon left of the arrows, hidden (wrapper opacity 0) until hover or keyboard focus, accent focus ring in dark, light/dark fine; Enter on 'Open <active> beside' is refused, on another row opens beside. Cosmetic only: hover-light shot shows the row's word count faintly behind the arrows (probably mid-fade). Residual, pre-existing (not U14): passage restore writes content then awaits queue.flush before bumping editorEpoch; typing into the restored entry's open editor during that await would overwrite the restore (same window existed single-pane). No text-loss path introduced by U14 found. Chromium only, no native (T129).

log.note:
T111 (U14 split view integration, agent-aec2) CLAIMED, Chromium-only evidence. Scope reduced by decision 'U13 absorbs U14 data-safety steps' (editorFor, FragmentLibrary activeIds, append routing, prune on delete were done and approved in T110 c2; re-verified here).

CHANGES
- src/components/ProjectSidebar.tsx: new optional prop onOpenBeside(target: PaneContent). Every manuscript and fragment row gets a button aria-label 'Open <title> beside' (title 'Open beside', 16 px Columns2) as the first child of the row action area .reorder, left of the reorder arrows. The .reorder wrapper now renders for fragment rows too (arrows still manuscript only), so the button inherits the existing reveal on :hover and :focus-within and the word-count swap. Keyboard: Tab from the row reaches it; Enter opens beside.
- src/App.tsx: sidebar navigation factored into selectEntry(id, beside) used by onSelect (Cmd/Ctrl+click) and onOpenBeside (same openBeside path). Five jump sites converted from 'close split + raw setActive' (U13 c2 safe default) to openEntry: New section/fragment (add), comment reattach (startReattachment), passage restore (restoreEntry), Comments Go to passage (onJump), read-title. openEntry now reads the split through splitRef (updated in render and synchronously in changeSplit and remove) so jumps that run after a dialog or an await use the panes as they are now. Whole-version restore (restoreVersion) KEEPS raw setActive + setSplit(null) per plan step 2 (comment updated). enter and new project unchanged (apply clears split on project change).
- Hardening for the reviewer residual 'editorFor trusts split state': editorFor now resolves from splitPanes (exactly what is rendered); a split that does not draw two panes maps to the single left Writer. extract (Keep as fragment) refuses unless the calling editor is editorFor(active), so an editor can never write a different entry. finishReattachment uses editorFor(reattachment.entryId) instead of editorRef.
- src/styles.css: no change needed (the button uses the existing .reorder rules). src/organization/FragmentLibrary.tsx, src/split.ts: no change (c2 already complete). tests/motion-u14.spec.ts registered but not created: U14 adds no animation.
- tests/split-view.spec.ts: the c2 case 'raw jump closes the split' rewritten to the U14 behaviour (New section replaces the focused pane, split stays, Keep as fragment from the right pane, One/Two untouched); new cases: open-beside on hover and Tab focus (opacity 0 -> 1, opens right pane, fragment beside a section, open-beside on the left entry does nothing, deleting the right pane's section closes the split); Go to passage into the unfocused pane (selection lands in that pane, Keep as fragment takes only that word); snapshot section restore with split open keeps both panes and shows restored text, typing after it saves.

ENTRY-CHANGING PATHS AUDIT (stop-and-ask check; none triggered): remove prunes (App.tsx ~931-946, now via splitRef); restoreVersion closes split (~1155); apply on project change clears (~462); add, extract, onCopy importFragment, restoreEntry only add or replace entries (applyRestorePatch maps only, revisionDiff.ts:339). Content writes outside an editor: appendFragment uses editorFor (pane editor) or writes an entry no pane shows; restoreEntry writes then bumps editorEpoch which remounts both panes; FragmentLibrary onEdit is read-only for any entry in a pane (activeIds); onEntryDetails and onTags patch metadata only and onEdit keeps metadata. Nothing new found.

FAIL-FIRST (pre-U14 build = untouched ui2-u13-c2/dist, config ui2-u14/ff.config.mjs port 1584): the 4 new/rewritten split-view cases all failed (ff.log, ff2.log: split closed, no open-beside button); amended probe P6, P7, P9-P15 all failed there (probe-ff.log 9/9 red).

PASS (build ui2-u14/dist, port 1584): tsc 0 (tsc.log); vitest split + save-queue 47/47 (vitest-split.log); full unit one worker 56 files 973/973 (unit.log); split-view.spec 10/10 (split1.log) and --repeat-each 3 29/30 twice (split3.log, split3b.log): the single failure each time is the U13 case 'shared bar menus' at line 202 (Font family Georgia not applied to the left selection), a pre-existing flake: the same case fails 2/8 on the pre-U14 c2 dist (menus2-c2.log) and passes 8/8 and 16/16 on this build in isolation (menus-u14.log, menus2-u14.log); not text loss (a font mark), disclosed in U13 c1 note. Amended probe ui2-u14/probe P1-P3, P5, P4b, P5b, P6-P15, P8 x3 48/48 (probe3.log). c2 probe copy P1-P5 5/5 (probe-c2.log). Reviewer original probe unmodified 7/10 (probe-orig.log): P4 fails only at its impossible precondition (card read-only since c2, as the c2 reviewer recorded); P6/P7 fail only at their split-pane count 0 line (292, 307) because U14 deliberately keeps the split. Related specs fragments-panel, research, footnotes, comments, revisions, housekeeping, sidebar-selection, accessibility, features, editor-toolbar 57/57 (post.log).

PROBE AMENDMENT (disclosed): ui2-u14/probe/split-safety.spec.mjs is a copy of the reviewer probe: P4 dropped (P4b covers it); P6/P7 replace the 'split closed' line with the new truth (two panes, jumped-to entry in the focused pane, breadcrumb agrees) and click the focused pane's editor explicitly; every data assertion unchanged. New: P9 New section with focus left + reload, P10 New fragment, P11 read-title for a section in neither pane, P12 Go to passage into the unfocused pane, P13 Reattach for the unfocused pane's section (anchor lands on that entry), P14 passage restore of the unfocused pane's section, P15 open-beside button; each ends with Keep as fragment (or typing in both panes) and storage checks that the other entries are untouched.

PLAN CONTRADICTION (recorded, not resolved silently): step 2 keeps version restore as raw setActive + clear split; step 5/6 talk about both panes remounting and 'restore a snapshot -> both panes show restored text'. I followed step 2 (a whole-project restore can remove pane entries) and wrote the step-6 test against section restore (restoreEntry), which keeps the split and remounts both panes.

SCREENSHOTS viewed (ui2-u14/shots): light/dark hover on a section row (open-beside icon left of the arrows), light/dark keyboard focus on the fragment row's button (accent focus ring), dark split after Enter. Flat, square, 16 px, no new colours.

BOUNDARIES: Chromium preview only; no native run (screen locked, T129); browser tests prove nothing about WKWebView, native storage or the Mac title bar. Not yet: SMOKE(14) native screenshots (blocked by T129). Hand-run note for the owner sheet item (j): hover a sidebar row and click the two-column icon, or Tab to it and press Enter; it opens beside.

DESIGN DOC: Sidebar rows -- each section and fragment row has an Open beside button (two-column icon, 16 px) at the right of the row, left of the reorder arrows, shown on hover or keyboard focus like the arrows; it does the same as Cmd/Ctrl+click. In split view, jumps (new section or fragment, Read manuscript titles, Go to passage, Reattach, passage restore) open the target in the focused pane, or focus the pane already showing it; restoring a whole snapshot closes the split.

RERUN: npx playwright test -c node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui2-u14/post.config.mjs split-view.spec.ts and -c ui2-u14/probe.config.mjs (rebuild ui2-u14/dist first if source changed).
